title: Industry physicist reads the propulsion technology from unreleased frames

tellings.quote: now. We spent observation in March and February, which were revealed to us technology that is used.

plain: Footage that has not been released, taken during observations in February and March 2025, revealed what technology the objects use to move, according to James Valor of Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call up UFOs and record them. Valor tells Michels he took part in those observations, and the story has a physicist from industry reading the propulsion method from the frames. If so, it would be a rare look at how such craft fly.
